resolve_once_settings.timeout_note: the main ladder (results/ladder.json) ran http_load.py with its default 10 s request timeout, this variant with 4 s; the timeout only decides which slow connections count as failures (failures are never timed)

proxy_note: The egress sidecar has no CPU limit (the server sets no [egress] requests or limits; no LimitRange in the sandbox namespace). The transparent proxy is one mitmdump process, so about one core (1000m) is its ceiling; a run where the sidecar's CPU over the load phase reached 800m is proxy-bound. The sidecar's CPU over the load comes from its own cumulative counter (sidecar_load_avg_cpu_m; unknown when the kubelet stamped fewer than two readings 10 s apart inside the load), else from its peak rate (sidecar_load_peak_cpu_m).
